finding_key: packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts::frontend's copy of parseblockstyle/serializeblockstyle was not hardened alongside the backend's, so documents already carrying the poisoned attributes still read as nan in the editor
evidence: The diff hardens serializeBlockStyle/parseBlockStyle only in packages/backend/src/yorkie/docs-tree.ts; its hunks in packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts touch only cell-style removal. The backend file's header explicitly states it mirrors the frontend store's reader/writer, and the frontend's visible serializeInlineStyle is verbatim-identical to the backend's, confirming the mirror. The pre-existing PUT validation (typeof b.style === 'object') accepted style:{} before this PR, so documents with "undefined" attributes can exist, and the frontend editor reads the CRDT directly — Number("undefined") → NaN survives the bare-spread normalizeBlockStyle, exactly the unrenderable-geometry failure the PR's own task doc describes. Confidence is medium only because the frontend's lines ~206-226 fall in an omitted excerpt region, so I verified the mirror relationship rather than the exact lines.
